objectives.statement: Identify common lexical s-verbs and explain their meanings in context.
Distinguish lexical s-verbs from passive s-forms by meaning and sentence role.
Use common present and simple past forms of lexical s-verbs in natural Bokmål sentences.
Build short sentences with lexical s-verbs for opinion, well-being, existence, and reciprocal actions.

notes: Must distinguish lexical s-verbs with active/reciprocal/existential meaning from passive s-forms. Include common inflected forms such as syntes, trivdes, fantes, møttes.
